problem: summary.management_risks[].rationale for the "Conversion / usability" dimension (build_management_risks, src/output/json/helpers.rs) formatted the optional performance/mobile scores via `{:?}` on an Option<u32>, producing a visible Rust Debug-format leak (e.g. "performance Some(84), mobile Some(77)", or "performance None" when a module wasn't run) instead of clean numbers.
evidence: Confirmed live in all 5 same-day single-report JSONs generated 2026-08-31 (casoon.de, satower-mosterei.de, sauerstoffzentrum-nordost.de, shop.satower-mosterei.de, säfte.com) during a report validation pass: every one of them had "performance Some(N), mobile Some(N)" verbatim in summary.management_risks[1].rationale. Originally also flagged by the report-critic skill's dry-run eval against reports/casoon-batch-en301549.json.
expected: rationale strings must format Option<u32> values as plain numbers via map/unwrap_or, never via {:?}; a missing score should read as a clean fallback ("not measured"), not "None".
counter_examples: A management_risks rationale for a dimension that has no optional score inputs at all (nothing to format), e.g. "Legal / BFSG-EAA" or "Trust / brand", is unaffected and must not be flagged.
